meta.title: Deep Learning Concept Map (Goodfellow et al.)

nodes.label: Artificial Intelligence
nodes.description: The broad goal of building intelligent machines

nodes.label: Machine Learning
nodes.description: Systems that improve with experience rather than being explicitly programmed

nodes.label: Representation Learning
nodes.description: Learning the representation itself, not just the mapping from representation to output

nodes.label: Deep Learning
nodes.description: Learning hierarchies of concepts built from simpler concepts across many layers

nodes.label: Scalars, Vectors, Matrices & Tensors
nodes.description: Fundamental mathematical objects: scalars, vectors, matrices, and higher-order tensors

nodes.label: Matrix Operations
nodes.description: Multiplication, inversion, norms, and systems of linear equations

nodes.label: Eigendecomposition
nodes.description: Decomposing a matrix into eigenvalues and eigenvectors

nodes.label: Singular Value Decomposition
nodes.description: Generalizing eigendecomposition to non-square matrices

nodes.label: PCA
nodes.description: Dimensionality reduction by projecting onto principal components

nodes.label: Trace & Determinant
nodes.description: Scalar summaries of matrices used in optimization and probability

nodes.label: Probability Distributions
nodes.description: PMFs, PDFs, and the rules governing uncertainty

nodes.label: Conditional Probability
nodes.description: Probability of events given that other events have occurred

nodes.label: Expectation & Variance
nodes.description: Summarizing distributions by their mean and spread

nodes.label: Common Distributions
nodes.description: Bernoulli, Gaussian, multinoulli, exponential, Laplace, and mixtures

nodes.label: Bayes' Rule
nodes.description: Updating beliefs given new evidence: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A)/P(B)

nodes.label: Information Theory
nodes.description: Entropy, KL divergence, and cross-entropy for quantifying information

nodes.label: Overflow & Underflow
nodes.description: Numerical pitfalls when representing real numbers in finite precision

nodes.label: Gradient-Based Optimization
nodes.description: Minimizing functions by following the gradient downhill

nodes.label: Jacobian & Hessian
nodes.description: First- and second-order derivative matrices for multivariable functions

nodes.label: Constrained Optimization
nodes.description: Optimization with equality/inequality constraints via KKT conditions and Lagrange multipliers

nodes.label: Learning Algorithms
nodes.description: Task T, performance measure P, experience E framework

nodes.label: Capacity & Overfitting
nodes.description: Model complexity, underfitting, overfitting, and the bias-variance tradeoff

nodes.label: Hyperparameters & Validation
nodes.description: Tuning settings not learned by training, using held-out validation sets

nodes.label: Estimators, Bias & Variance
nodes.description: Point estimation, bias, variance, consistency, and the bias-variance tradeoff

nodes.label: Maximum Likelihood Estimation
nodes.description: Choosing parameters that maximize the probability of observed data

nodes.label: Bayesian Statistics
nodes.description: Using prior distributions over parameters and updating via Bayes' rule

nodes.label: Supervised Learning
nodes.description: Learning from labeled input-output pairs (classification and regression)

nodes.label: Unsupervised Learning
nodes.description: Discovering structure in unlabeled data (clustering, density estimation)

nodes.label: Feedforward Networks
nodes.description: The basic deep learning model: layers of learned affine transforms and nonlinearities

nodes.label: Gradient-Based Learning
nodes.description: Training neural networks by computing gradients of a cost function

nodes.label: Hidden Units
nodes.description: Neurons in intermediate layers that learn internal representations

nodes.label: Activation Functions
nodes.description: Nonlinearities like ReLU, sigmoid, and tanh applied to hidden units

nodes.label: Output Units
nodes.description: Final layer units: linear, sigmoid, or softmax depending on the task

nodes.label: Architecture Design
nodes.description: Choosing depth, width, and connectivity patterns for neural networks

nodes.label: Backpropagation
nodes.description: Efficiently computing gradients via the chain rule applied layer by layer

nodes.label: Parameter Norm Penalties
nodes.description: Adding a penalty on weight magnitudes to the loss function

nodes.label: L1 & L2 Regularization
nodes.description: Weight decay (L2) and sparsity-inducing (L1) penalties

nodes.label: Dropout
nodes.description: Randomly zeroing units during training as a form of ensemble regularization

nodes.label: Data Augmentation
nodes.description: Creating fake training data via transformations to reduce overfitting

nodes.label: Early Stopping
nodes.description: Halting training when validation error stops improving

nodes.label: Ensemble Methods
nodes.description: Combining multiple models to reduce generalization error

nodes.label: Batch Normalization
nodes.description: Normalizing layer inputs to stabilize and accelerate training

nodes.label: Stochastic Gradient Descent
nodes.description: Approximating the full gradient using random minibatches

nodes.label: Momentum
nodes.description: Accumulating a velocity vector to accelerate SGD in consistent directions

nodes.label: Learning Rate Schedules
nodes.description: Strategies for decaying or adapting the step size during training

nodes.label: Adam Optimizer
nodes.description: Adaptive learning rates using first and second moment estimates

nodes.label: Second-Order Methods
nodes.description: Newton's method, conjugate gradients, and other curvature-aware optimizers

nodes.label: Batch Norm (Optimization)
nodes.description: Batch normalization as an optimization technique for smoother loss surfaces

nodes.label: Parameter Initialization
nodes.description: Strategies for setting initial weights to enable effective training

nodes.label: Convolution Operation
nodes.description: Applying learned kernels that share weights across spatial locations

nodes.label: Pooling
nodes.description: Downsampling feature maps to achieve translation invariance

nodes.label: CNN Architecture
nodes.description: Stacking convolution, pooling, and fully connected layers for vision tasks

nodes.label: Convolution Variants
nodes.description: Strided, dilated, tiled, and locally connected convolutions

nodes.label: Unfolding Computational Graphs
nodes.description: Representing recurrence as a deep feedforward graph over time steps

nodes.label: RNN Architecture
nodes.description: Networks with recurrent connections for processing sequential data

nodes.label: Bidirectional RNN
nodes.description: Processing sequences in both forward and backward directions

nodes.label: Encoder-Decoder
nodes.description: Mapping variable-length input sequences to variable-length output sequences

nodes.label: Long-Term Dependencies
nodes.description: The challenge of learning to connect information across many time steps

nodes.label: LSTM
nodes.description: Gated recurrent units with explicit memory cells that mitigate vanishing gradients

nodes.label: GRU
nodes.description: A simplified gated architecture alternative to LSTM

nodes.label: Echo State Networks
nodes.description: RNNs with fixed random recurrent weights and only trained output weights
